app_store_connect.subtitle: Psychological Assessment Tool
app_store_connect.description:
APGI Explorer is a comprehensive psychological assessment tool based on the Adult Psychological Growth Inventory. Discover your psychological growth profile through scientifically validated assessments, track your progress over time, and export detailed reports for research purposes.

Key Features:
• Comprehensive APGI assessment with validated psychological metrics
• Visual charts and progress tracking
• Cloud synchronization across all your devices
• Export to multiple formats including PDF, CSV, SPSS, Stata, and R
• Multi-language support (English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese)
• Privacy-focused with local data storage
• Research-grade export capabilities for academic use

Perfect for psychologists, researchers, students, and individuals interested in personal psychological development and growth assessment.
app_store_connect.app_store_review_notes: This is a psychological assessment tool designed for educational and research purposes. All data is stored locally and optionally synced via iCloud. No personal data is collected or transmitted without user consent.
app_store_connect.whats_new:
Version 1.0 includes:

• Cloud synchronization support

• Comprehensive privacy features
